podcast.body: An alternate, formerly lost, and unknown take of "Heroin," a key song from the Velvet Underground's 1966 debut album, was found on a brittle aluminum acetate from the Scepter Studios Sessions. This test pressing, considered honest-to-god history from the band regarded as the first alt-rock group, was eventually ripped to MP3 to preserve it. "It's Lou Reed and the Velvet Underground with a different take of the song, Heroin."
